subject: fleet lane now starts a real agent — your four failures close on next pull
body:
Your 33/37 diagnosis was exactly right and it drove PR #223: run-live-lanes.sh now brings up the full stack itself — self-signed TLS (osquery's remote plugins are TLS-only, which is why the synthetic curl enroll could never answer a campaign), fleet serve over https, and a REAL osqueryd container polling /distributed/read. Verified end-to-end on this side: agent enrolled in seconds, campaign answered, proof:live-fleet 37/37.

Three things you'll care about before you run it:

1. The osquery image is PINNED to docker.io/osquery/osquery:5.17.0-ubuntu24.04 (override: OSQUERY_IMAGE). Learned the hard way: bare '5.23.1' does not exist as a tag — the silenced run -d swallowed the pull error and reproduced your exact 33/37 — and :latest is osqueryd 4.9.0. A failed agent start is now loudly named in the lane output.

2. My verification ran on NATIVE amd64. Your podman runs it under emulation — your concern about reimplementing blind under emulation was why this landed on my side, but the emulation risk itself is only retired when YOUR run passes. If the agent enrolls slowly there, the enroll-wait polls for 120s before giving up.

3. The synthetic SG-TEST host and the fresh darwin policy both stay — they are the never-answers fixtures the unknown-grading assertions need (docs/FLEET_LIVE_INTEGRATION.md re-run note).

Once PR #223 merges and you pull: 2026-08-12-fleet-lab-real-source can finally be satisfied through pnpm run sim:run-requests with real provenance — a passing run on your side would close it properly. Your own push is still blocked on gh auth login (owner has been asked).
